newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: INPARSA HITS HIGH ON GOOD TELECOMS OUTLOOK.
newsitem.headline: INPARSA HITS HIGH ON GOOD TELECOMS OUTLOOK.

text.p: A positive outlook for telecommunications and industry in Portugal boosted shares in holding company Inparsa-SGPS, which is leading a consortium bidding for Portugal's third mobile telephone licence.
At 0940 GMT the stock was up 100 escudos at 3,949 on volume of 128,100 after earlier touching a high of 3,980 escudos.
"It looks like we might break through 4,000 escudos, if not today then soon. It will depend on whether market sentiment remains generally upbeat," said one trader.

Inparsa announced earlier it was increasing its capital to 29.25 billion from 19.50 billion by issuing 4,875,000 new shares at 3,000 escudos each and by incorporating 4.875 billion escudos into its reserves.
Dealers said the capital increase, which had been expected to weigh on share prices, had had little effect on the stock.
Inparsa is part of the Sonae industrial group.
